rationale: No story/spec artifact was available for this run (sdlc-light has no spec.md), so the acceptance lens was skipped (no-spec mode) and confidence is forced low per the gate's degradation rule. Blind and edge-case lenses both ran successfully against the diff. One actionable gap survived triage: AC4 ("the error is logged with enough diagnostic information") is not exercised by any test — neither new test asserts that logger.error was actually called with the agent name and error message. The remaining lens findings (error.message getter throwing, logger.error itself throwing, non-Error rejection values untested, exitCode test's fake adapter never actually exercising forwardOtlpEventsToSpool) are real but low-probability/low-value edge cases given the concrete error types this path actually receives (plain Error instances from daemon-manager.ts); they are recorded as deferred rather than blocking. 2 findings dismissed as out-of-scope or already-verified (log-level style note; concern about unrelated dirty files, which are confirmed not part of this diff).

standards_review.notes: No dedicated security-patterns guide exists in this repo; no concrete security issue identified in the diff (logged value is only an Error#message string from internal daemon-manager.ts throw sites, no secrets/profile/URL content).

findings.problem: AC4 ("the error is logged with enough diagnostic information") has no test coverage. Neither the OtlpAgentAdapter.test.ts swallow-and-continue test nor the hook.analytics-wiring.test.ts exit-code test asserts that logger.error was called, or with what message, when ensureOtlpProxy rejects.
findings.impact: A future change that silently removes or weakens the logger.error call in the catch block (src/agents/core/OtlpAgentAdapter.ts:103-108) would ship with all existing tests green, making the failure mode invisible end-to-end — exactly the regression this ticket exists to prevent visibility into.
findings.recommendation: Add an assertion in OtlpAgentAdapter.test.ts's new 'swallows an ensureOtlpProxy failure' test: spy on the mocked logger.error and assert it was called with a message containing the agent name ('fake') and the rejection's error message.
